clips.title: The story
paras: Following the blueprints provided by the tinker Cog, Viktori Prism'Antras seeks a reflective surface to assemble his observatory telescope in Darkshire. He directs travelers to southern Duskwood to locate Mary, a local woman remembered for carrying a looking glass.

Having secured a bronze tube for his telescope, Viktori Prism'Antras turns to the next requirement outlined in Cog's blueprints: a reliable mirror to direct and reflect light through the device. Rather than forging fine silvered glass from scratch amidst the shortages plaguing Darkshire, Viktori recalls Mary, a local resident known across the region for always carrying a looking glass.

Mary's former residence lies deep in southern Duskwood, just north of the haunted Tranquil Gardens Cemetery. Seeking her out takes adventurers past the safe patrol borders of the Night Watch and into blighted groves teeming with ravenous wolves, feral spiders, and wandering undead.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: According to Cog's blueprint, what I need now is a way to reflect light. I remember a woman by the name of Mary who became well known around these parts for always carrying a looking glass. Perhaps you can track Mary down and see if she might lend us a reflective surface for this project? I believe she once resided in southern Duskwood...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Why yes, I used to own a looking glass.
